0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Parbeloix is in search of someone skilled with a weapon.

24.original: Consult the illustration to find and obtain sample 316.

48.original: <hex:02080FE905FF064D6164616DFF0453697203>, I say, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. I seem to be in a bit of a bind, and I was wondering if you might lend your aid to remedy the plight of a struggling student.

49.original: Oh, of course─introductions. I am Parbeloix, from the Studium, where my research involves the finer points of bacteria and fungi.

50.original: I'm here to harvest mushrooms from Labyrinthos for my experiments, but I'm afraid I may be in over my head.

51.original: You see, the mushrooms are located in the thirty-third facet, but that shaft is positively swarming with things I can scarce stand to look at, let alone face in combat.

52.original: It isn't uncommon for members of the Studium to request help from the more martially inclined, and so here I am before you. Will you procure the mushrooms for me? I would be forever in your debt.

53.original: Oh, thank you, good <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>! Well then, the sample number for my plot is three-one-six. The mushrooms stand out among the others, with red caps and a distinctive triangle shape.

54.original: Just in case, however, I do have this illustration. I understand all too well the impulse to become lost gazing at the fungi─perhaps this will help keep you on track.

55.original: If you find the sheer variety of mushrooms to be overwhelming, then simply consult the picture and it should put you back on track.

56.original: Please return with the crop labeled sample three-one-six. If you forget how they look, simply consult the illustration I gave you and resume the merry harvest.

57.original: These don't appear to be the correct mushrooms, although they do have a certain charm...

58.original: This appears to be an illustration of sample 316. Find the matching mushrooms within the vast thirty-third facet.

59.original: These mushrooms match the illustration in your hands. Your long search is over!

60.original: Well, I can see by the dirt on your boots that you did some manner of digging. Were you able to find my sample?

61.original: Ah, yes, these match my illustration exactly! Thank the Twelve that the brave of heart still walk this realm.

62.original: Do you have an interest in fungi yourself? These were developed from the spores of the elfstool, which can only be found in the Aurum Vale. A rare mushroom, but these are superior in every way.

63.original: For one, they are much less inclined to kill you. A vast improvement by any measure of the word.

64.original: Of course, I've had my failures, but the less said about those, the better. What matters is now, and the revolution sample three-one-six is sure to herald!
